literature_notes: BEST1 (Bestrophin-1) has a 4-TM topology with two short extracellular loops (ECL1: residues 54–71; ECL2: residues 253–270) and no extracellular terminus. The entire N-terminus (1–31) and C-terminus (289–585) are intracellular. Every ledger line (L1–L8) describes tags placed at intracellular positions: L1–L4 and L8 report C-terminal BRIL-3xFLAG or Flag fusions (intracellular, after residue 585), and L5–L7 report N-terminal Flag fusions (intracellular, before residue 1). No ledger line describes any insertion in ECL1, ECL2, or any other extracellular region of BEST1 or a close ortholog. Because the rules require every site to be grounded in one ledger line reporting a tolerated insertion at or in the same extracellular loop/domain, and no such line exists, zero extracellular surface sites qualify. The C-terminal and N-terminal positions are recorded in other_positions.

literature_other_positions.note: C-terminal BRIL-3xFLAG tag after the last residue (S585) of the intracellular C-tail; validated by whole-cell patch-clamp, surface biotinylation, and cryo-EM — but the C-terminus is cytoplasmic, not extracellular.

N-terminal Flag tag on hBEST1 (before M1) showed significantly lower expression than C-terminally tagged or untagged protein; the N-terminus is intracellular and this position also impairs expression.
